title: Prospective confirmation of a depth-wise causal-support funnel
question: Across fresh behavior-qualified free Transformers, does the smallest independently confirmed exact-state support contract monotonically with depth and terminate at the answer position?

dependency.candidate_only: causal support size decreases with depth

models.selection_rule: first three seeds passing behavior-only qualification

hard_stops: Behavior screening may inspect outputs and qualification metrics only; rejected seeds receive no hidden-state measurement.
Every admitted model and every layer remains in the mechanism denominator.
Exact oracle population scores are audit truth and cannot select a support family.
The full-sequence positive control cannot authorize the funnel claim.
A final-layer answer-only replay cannot pass without early distributed support and strict depth-wise contraction.
No donor compiler is designed or fit in this phase.
No Qwen3, GLM4, DS7B, or other pretrained model is loaded in this phase.
One formal run, no adaptive rerun, no threshold revision after reveal.
